capabilities: fetch Jira issues and save them as Markdown notes from a customizable template
update individual or all tracked issue notes with commands or a status bar button
create issue notes from text selected in the editor
manage the Jira connection and tracked issues in the settings tab
extras: Not yet listed in the community plugins directory, so it must be installed manually from GitHub Releases; supports ignoring TLS certificate errors for self-signed Jira servers.
problem: Obsidian cannot fetch issue data from Jira, so notes about tickets must be filled in by hand and go stale as issue status changes.
summary: Jira integration that creates Markdown notes from Jira issues and keeps tracked issue notes updated from your Jira server.
